reviews.text: Very much enjoyed this game - it's really immersive and fun but not a brainrot - if you want to improve your time you have to think of a logical strategy. There's definitely a lot of time and effort put into creating this game, so it's a pleasure to play!
Fun game and very involving - it's hard to stop playing. Nice graphics
Really immersive and catchy

Also played beta/playtest for several hours. Quite nice game. Mechanics are basic at first, but improve in depth after purchasing right upgrades. To get decent scores for leaderboard, it will take some trial and error to choose correct upgrades (and luck).

Great game, steal for the price!!! Took me about 3 hours to beat as a big idle/clicker veteran, and there's also a leaderboard system for min/max lovers The mechanics are great, not too shallow, not too complicated, and the phasing is spot on. Game also feels and looks really great and smooth. Recommended 100%
Supply and demand: the game your GPU might start wheezing towards the end
This is a pretty fun little incremental that lasts a few hours. You can be passive or active. Not a bad way to spend a few bucks.

It's hard to recommend this one. The mechanics are ok, the dopamine kick is there (albeit a bit low for this type of games), the previous version I played a while ago (demo?) was promising, but the full version really feels like a demo. I'm not sure if I did something wrong, but I reached the end game with everything unlocked in 1.7 hours according to steam (and I paused the game for more than 15 minutes at some point). This is low, way too low. Did I miss anything obvious?
Nice game to chill if u want it to be
Short and sweet
就算以这个价格的体量而言，也是过于简短了。但是看着人山人海还是很解压的。
Short and fun incremental game. It is a bit slow at the start but progression gets faster the longer you play. Doesn't overstays its welcome.
Nice little game. I recommend giving it a try.

Also played playtest version. This is a good short clicker game. This can be easily finished in an afternoon which is nice since you dont have to forcibly spend time away like some other idle type clicker games. After finishing the game there you can try to improve your times to get higher on the leaderbord which is cool
Pretty short game, but a very fun experience. I wish there was a little more gameplay between the full automation stage and the end of the game, but it was still a good game.

Good hour or so long game, also a good way to spend 3 hours getting all the achievements. you could probably enjoy this game in the background too, after one of the automatic upgrades you can probably get 5-10ish minutes into the game the rest is easy. though there are other upgrades that help you manually click too. you can also freely refund any and all upgrades without loss. very nicely made game that isn't too punishing in any form or way.

Imho the game has a very shalllow and retrained scope. The formula is not particulary enjoyable. There is a time gated "income" mechanism which imho is broken. Because going to sleep actually ended the game for me. I have 9hours played, I think I finished it in actual 45mn at most, it's 45mn perceived but it was so tedious, maybe just 20 or 30. Not ideal for a game with a price tag.
Pretty good game albeit a bit short. Interesting mechanic with global ranking
capitalism but further beyond
fun game, wish there was more content tho

A game from Lithuania!
Sell boxes, get rich! A cosmic logistics tycoon game. Needs active mouse restocking. Fun mid-game, but late-game growth spikes insanely, ending too fast. Still, better than dragging on forever.
